posts.name: ZAUFISHAN AYAZAHMED RANGINWALA
posts.cooked:
Who all are allowed to attempt Re-OPPE?
Actually I had completed 2 questions, then by mistake I changed the solution of 1 so at the end of exam only 1 answer was correct. Now I am getting 50 marks so I am passing the exam. But marks are more than expected.
I hope these marks are final and won’t change. If I am not allowed to give the ReOPPE and these marks change after re-evaluation, I will fail in the ReOPPE.

Please look into this and confirm as soon as possible.
@Subendu @Sushil1

posts.name: ParamanandaSamantara
posts.cooked:
Dear Sir @sushil1 @Subendu I have just cleared 1 question in oppe that q4 sed and at first received 7 but it got updated to 40 .

but I received a mail regarding reattempting reoppe .

I really want to give the reoppe as there has been some grace marks given from your side to pass.

please confirm can I give the reoppe or not?

posts.name: Srujan Patwardhan
posts.cooked:
Dear Team,

I am writing to confirm the process for marks consideration between the first and second OPPE attempts. Although I have obtained a passing score in the first OPPE, I would like to reattempt the second OPPE to improve my marks.

Could you please clarify whether the final marks will be based on the first attempt, the second attempt, or the higher of the two scores? I kindly request that the maximum marks out of the two attempts be considered, allowing students like me the opportunity to improve, similar to those who did not pass the first OPPE.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
@sushil1 @Subendu

posts.name: sushil_sys
posts.cooked: Dear student the reOPPE is only for the students who either failed or absent in oppe. The absentee has to connect to support with legit reasoning to attend the ReOPPE. In case you have passed the oppe you will be ineligible for reOPPE.
